entry.name: jit.buffer~
entry.digest: Access an MSP buffer~ in matrix form
entry.description: Represents audio in a float32 matrix with time across dim[0]. Multi-channel audio uses a separate plane for each channel. The object arguments are the same as those for the buffer~ object. jit.buffer~ responds to all the same messages as buffer~.

attributes.name: vizmode
attributes.digest: Opaque rendering mode
attributes.description: A value of 1 turns on opaque rendering mode. A value of 2 turns on statistical rendering mode, which has greater detail but is more expensive to render. A value of 0 turns off visualization and all background processing of cached speedup data. (default=0)

attributes.name: vizwidth
